SELECT distinct decode(tpd.is_cancel,'Y',#{TRADE_FLOW_STATUS03},#{TRADE_FLOW_STATUS02}) effectFlag,
FROM trd_product_deal tpd LEFT JOIN trd_product_deal_add tpda ON tpd.trade_id = tpda.trade_id left join WFL_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL_OTH wtpdo on wtpdo.TRADE_ID = tpd.TRADE_ID left join TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL tpdt on tpd.TOTLE_TRADE_ID=tpdt.TOTLE_TRADE_ID LEFT JOIN PTL_PORTFOLIO pp ON tpda.portfolio_id = pp.portfolio_id LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT fp ON tpd.finprod_id = fp.finprod_id left join SYS_DATADICT_LIST sdl_registorg on fp.REGIST_ORG=sdl_registorg.ITEM_CODE and sdl_registorg.DICT_CODE='REGIST_ORG' LEFT JOIN MST_COUNTER_PARTY mcp ON tpd.counter_id = mcp.counter_id LEFT JOIN TRD_TRADE_FEE_DETAIL ttft ON tpd.trade_id = ttft.trade_id AND ttft.fee_type =#{feeType06} LEFT JOIN TRD_TRADE_FEE_DETAIL ttft1 ON tpd.trade_id = ttft1.trade_id AND ttft1.fee_type =#{feeType08} LEFT JOIN STL_SEC_ACCT_INFO ssai ON tpd.sec_manage_acct_id = ssai.SEC_ACCT_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE fpt ON tpd.FINPROD_ID = fpt.FINPROD_ID left join FIN_TRADE_PRODUCT FTP on tpd.FINPROD_ID = FTP.FINPROD_ID left join FIN_DEAL_PLEDGE on tpd.FINPROD_ID = FIN_DEAL_PLEDGE.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT fp2 ON fp2.FINPROD_ID = tpd.CHL_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT fp3 ON fp3.FINPROD_ID = FIN_DEAL_PLEDGE.PLEDGE_FINPROD_ID WHERE tpd.TRADE_ID in (SELECT TRADE_ID FROM trd_product_deal_add WHERE ENTRUST_ID = #{entrustId}) OR tpd.B_TRADE_ID in (SELECT TRADE_ID FROM trd_product_deal_add WHERE ENTRUST_ID = #{entrustId}) union all SELECT #{TRADE_FLOW_STATUS01} effectFlag,
FROM wfl_trd_product_deal tpd LEFT JOIN wfl_trd_product_deal_add tpda ON tpd.trade_id = tpda.trade_id left join WFL_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL_OTH wtpdo on wtpdo.TRADE_ID = tpd.TRADE_ID left join WFL_TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL tpdt on tpd.TOTLE_TRADE_ID=tpdt.TOTLE_TRADE_ID LEFT JOIN PTL_PORTFOLIO pp ON tpda.portfolio_id = pp.portfolio_id LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT fp ON tpd.finprod_id = fp.finprod_id left join SYS_DATADICT_LIST sdl_registorg on fp.REGIST_ORG=sdl_registorg.ITEM_CODE and sdl_registorg.DICT_CODE='REGIST_ORG' LEFT JOIN MST_COUNTER_PARTY mcp ON tpd.counter_id = mcp.counter_id LEFT JOIN TRD_TRADE_FEE_DETAIL ttft ON tpd.trade_id = ttft.trade_id AND ttft.fee_type =#{feeType06} LEFT JOIN TRD_TRADE_FEE_DETAIL ttft1 ON tpd.trade_id = ttft1.trade_id AND ttft1.fee_type =#{feeType08} LEFT JOIN STL_SEC_ACCT_INFO ssai ON tpd.sec_manage_acct_id = ssai.SEC_ACCT_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE fpt ON tpd.FINPROD_ID = fpt.FINPROD_ID left join FIN_TRADE_PRODUCT FTP on tpd.FINPROD_ID = FTP.FINPROD_ID left join FIN_DEAL_PLEDGE on tpd.FINPROD_ID = FIN_DEAL_PLEDGE.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT fp2 ON fp2.FINPROD_ID = tpd.CHL_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT fp3 ON fp3.FINPROD_ID = FIN_DEAL_PLEDGE.PLEDGE_FINPROD_ID WHERE tpd.TRADE_ID in (SELECT TRADE_ID FROM wfl_trd_product_deal_add WHERE ENTRUST_ID = #{entrustId}) OR tpd.B_TRADE_ID in (SELECT TRADE_ID FROM wfl_trd_product_deal_add WHERE ENTRUST_ID = #{entrustId})

tpda.portfolio_id portfolioId, pp.portfolio_name portfolioName, fp.finprod_market_id finprodMarketId, fp.finprod_abbr finprodAbbr, to_char(tpd.trade_date,'yyyy-MM-dd') tradeDate, tpd.ccy ccy, eea.PAY_TYPE as payType, BO.WIN_PRIN_AMT/10000 as winPrinAmt, eea.LISTING_DATE as listingDate, to_char(BO.WIN_PRICE * 100,'fm99990.0000') || '%' as winPrice, BO.WIN_TYPE as winType, BO.PAY_DATE as payDate, fpt.TYPE_6 paBussType, fpt.TYPE_9 assetType1, fpt.TYPE_10 assetType10, fpt.TYPE_11 assetType11, tpd.totle_trade_id totleTradeId, tpd.trade_id tradeId, tpda.portfolio_id portfolioId, pp.portfolio_name portfolioName, fp.finprod_market_id finprodMarketId, fp.finprod_abbr finprodAbbr, to_char(tpd.trade_date,'yyyy-MM-dd') tradeDate, tpd.ccy ccy, tpd.counter_id counterId, mcp.counter_name counterName, tpd.remark remark FROM wfl_trd_product_deal tpd LEFT JOIN wfl_trd_product_deal_add tpda ON tpd.trade_id = tpda.trade_id left join WFL_TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL tpdt on tpd.TOTLE_TRADE_ID=tpdt.TOTLE_TRADE_ID LEFT JOIN PTL_PORTFOLIO pp ON tpda.portfolio_id = pp.portfolio_id LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT fp ON tpd.finprod_id = fp.finprod_id LEFT JOIN MST_COUNTER_PARTY mcp ON tpd.counter_id = mcp.counter_id LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE fpt ON tpd.FINPROD_ID = fpt.FINPROD_ID left join WFL_ETR_ENTRUST ee on tpda.ENTRUST_ID=ee.ENTRUST_ID left join WFL_ETR_ENTRUST_ADD eea on ee.ENTRUST_ID=eea.ENTRUST_ID left join BID_ORDER_BID_PRICE bobp on ee.ENTRUST_ID=bobp.ENTRUST_ID left join BID_ORDER BO ON bobp.bid_id = BO.BID_ID WHERE tpda.entrust_id = #{entrustId}

SELECT DISTINCT su.USER_NAME as userName, su.REAL_NAME as realName, to_char(NVL(a.totalWork, 0), 'fm999990.009') as totalWork, to_char(NVL(b.unfinishedWork, 0), 'fm999990.009') as unfinishedWork FROM SYS_USER su INNER JOIN SYS_USER_ROLE sur ON su.USER_NAME = sur.USER_ID INNER JOIN SYS_ROLE sr ON sur.ROLE_ID = sr.ROLE_ID AND sr.ROLE_POS in ('06') LEFT JOIN ( select TRADER,sum(totalWork) totalWork from ( SELECT edi.TRADER as TRADER, COUNT(edi.TRADER) AS totalWork FROM ETR_DISTRIBUTE edi LEFT JOIN ETR_ENTRUST een ON edi.ENTRUST_ID = een.ENTRUST_ID where een.ENTRUST_STATUS in ('04') and een.FINISH_DATE = to_date(#{sysDate},'yyyy-mm-dd') GROUP BY edi.TRADER union all SELECT edi.TRADER as TRADER, COUNT(edi.TRADER) AS totalWork FROM ETR_DISTRIBUTE edi LEFT JOIN ETR_ENTRUST een ON edi.ENTRUST_ID = een.ENTRUST_ID where een.ENTRUST_STATUS in ('02','03') GROUP BY edi.TRADER ) t group by TRADER ) a ON su.USER_NAME = a.TRADER LEFT JOIN ( select TRADER,sum(unfinishedWork) unfinishedWork from ( SELECT edi.TRADER as TRADER, COUNT(edi.TRADER) AS unfinishedWork FROM ETR_DISTRIBUTE edi LEFT JOIN ETR_ENTRUST een ON edi.ENTRUST_ID = een.ENTRUST_ID where een.ENTRUST_STATUS in ('02') GROUP BY edi.TRADER union all SELECT edi.TRADER as TRADER, sum(1 - round(case when een.TRADE_MARKET = '03' OR een.TRADE_MARKET = '04' THEN ( CASE WHEN eena.TARGET_TYPE = '01' THEN ROUND( DECODE(NVL( efs.ENT_FINISH_AMT, 0 ),0,0, NVL( efs.ENT_FINISH_AMT, 0 )/ NVL( een.ENTRUST_NUM, 1 )), 4 ) ELSE ROUND( DECODE(NVL( efs.ENT_FINISH_AMT, 0 ),0,0,NVL( efs.ENT_FINISH_AMT, 0 )/ NVL( een.ENTRUST_AMT, 1 )), 4 ) END ) else (decode(eena.ASSET_TYPE,'F01',NVL(ees.FINISH_AMT * 100,0),'F10',NVL(ees.FINISH_AMT * 100,0),'F10',NVL(ees.FINISH_AMT *100,0),'F17',NVL(ees.FINISH_AMT * 100,0),NVL(ees.FINISH_AMT,0))/ decode(eena.ASSET_TYPE,'F01',decode(een.PS,'T03',een.ENTRUST_AMT, NVL(een.ENTRUST_NUM * 100,0)),'F10',NVL(een.ENTRUST_NUM *100,0),'F17',NVL(een.ENTRUST_NUM *100,0),NVL(een.ENTRUST_AMT,een.ENTRUST_NUM * 100))) END ,2)) unfinishedWork FROM ETR_DISTRIBUTE edi LEFT JOIN ETR_ENTRUST een ON edi.ENTRUST_ID = een.ENTRUST_ID left join ETR_ENTRUST_ADD eena on een.ENTRUST_ID=eena.ENTRUST_ID left join ETR_FINISH_STATUS efs ON efs.ENTRUST_ID = een.ENTRUST_ID AND een.ENTRUST_ID = efs.TRADE_ID left join (SELECT ENTRUST_ID,SUM(FINISH_AMT) AS FINISH_AMT FROM ETR_FINISH_STATUS WHERE ENTRUST_ID != TRADE_ID GROUP BY ENTRUST_ID) ees on een.ENTRUST_ID=ees.ENTRUST_ID where een.ENTRUST_STATUS in ('03') GROUP BY edi.TRADER ) t group by TRADER ) b ON b.TRADER = su.USER_NAME

mapper.select: SELECT T1.REAL_NAME realName FROM SYS_USER T1 where T1.USER_NAME = #{userName}

SELECT T9.ENTRUST_ID, LISTAGG(to_char(T9.BID_PRICE * 100,'fm99990.0000') || '%', ',') WITHIN GROUP (order by (T9.BID_PRICE * 100)) etrPrice, CASE WHEN T10.BID_ID IS NULL THEN '01' WHEN T10.TRADE_ID IS NOT NULL THEN '05' WHEN T10.IS_WIN IS NOT NULL THEN DECODE(T10.IS_WIN,'Y','04','N','03',T10.IS_WIN) ELSE '02' END isWin FROM ETR_ENTRUST_BID_PRICE T9 LEFT JOIN BID_ORDER_BID_PRICE T10 ON T10.ENTRUST_ID = T9.ENTRUST_ID AND T10.BID_PRICE = T9.BID_PRICE where T9.ENTRUST_ID=#{entrustId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} GROUP BY T9.ENTRUST_ID, T10.BID_ID, T10.IS_WIN,T10.TRADE_ID

SELECT round(ETAF.FINISH_AMT / ET.ENTRUST_NUM,4) * 100 as dealProgress, round(ETAF.FINISH_AMT/100,2) as transFinishAmt, round((ET.ENTRUST_NUM-ETAF.FINISH_AMT) / 100,2) as transRemainderAmt from ETR_ENTRUST ET inner join ETR_ENTRUST_ADD ETA on ET.ENTRUST_ID=ETA.ENTRUST_ID left join (SELECT ETR_FINISH_STATUS.ENTRUST_ID, sum(FINISH_AMT) AS FINISH_AMT FROM ETR_FINISH_STATUS GROUP BY ENTRUST_ID) ETAF on ET.ENTRUST_ID=ETAF.ENTRUST_ID where ET.ENTRUST_ID=#{entrustId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}

select listagg(ea.DISPENSE_PARA,',') WITHIN GROUP ( order by er.VDATE) distributeParameter, er.DISPENSE_RULE distributeRule, to_char(er.VDATE,'yyyy-MM-dd') vdate, to_char(er.MDATE,'yyyy-MM-dd') mdate from ETR_AUTO_DISPENSE_RULE er left join ETR_AUTO_DISPENSE_RULE_DETAIL ea on er.RULE_ID = ea.RULE_ID
and er.VDATE <= to_date(#{sysDate},'yyyy-mm-dd') and er.MDATE >= to_date(#{sysDate},'yyyy-mm-dd')
group by er.DISPENSE_RULE, er.VDATE, er.MDATE

select OUTPUT_VALUE_1 from FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE_CONFIG btm left join ETR_ENTRUST ON (ETR_ENTRUST.FINPROD_TYPE2 = btm.INPUT_VALUE_2 OR btm.INPUT_VALUE_2 is null) AND (ETR_ENTRUST.Ps = btm.INPUT_VALUE_3 OR btm.INPUT_VALUE_3 is null) AND (ETR_ENTRUST.TRADE_PLAT = btm.INPUT_VALUE_1 OR btm.INPUT_VALUE_1 IS NULL) where ETR_ENTRUST.ENTRUST_ID=#{entrustId}

' || to_char(eted.MDATE2,'yyyy-MM-dd') as dueDate, eted.TERM_DAYS repoTerm, eted.FIRST_UNIT_CPRICE || ' - ' || eted.FIRST_UNIT_CPRICE2 firstprice, pss.pledge_stock_name pledgeStockName, eted.ASSET_TYPE assetType, ete.INV_MANAGER_ID invManagerId, eted.TARGET_TYPE targetType, mcpdata.COUNTER_NAME counterId, eted.COUNTER_SEAT counterSeat, eted.COUNTER_CON_NO counterConNo, eted.TRADER trader, ete.COUNTER_TRADER counterTrader, FPC.CON_SHARE_ID conId, T5.FINPROD_NAME conName, eted.EXP_CON_VALUE expConValue, eted.EXP_CON_NUM expConNum, eted.PREB preb, eted.PREC prec, fpt.TYPE_11 secType, sci.ACCT_NAME dealCurAcct, eted.REQUEST_ID requestId, eted.CAP_DAYS capDays, to_char(eted.VPAY_DATE,'yyyy-MM-dd') vpayDate, to_char(eted.MPAY_DATE,'yyyy-MM-dd') mpayDate, eted.M_INT_AMT mIntAmt, eted.M_TRADE_AMT mTradeAmt, nvl(decode( eted.ASSET_TYPE, 'F07' , ee.Pledge_Ratio , fscr.SCALE ), 0 ) * 100 pledgeRatio, /** 折算率 **/ ee.PLEDGE_NUMBER pledgeNumber, ee.PLEDGE_NUMBER * ee.Pledge_Face_Value pledStrdPrinAmt, eted.TRADE_ID tradeId, oee.Pledge_Ratio * 100 oldPledgeRatio, /** 折算率 **/ oee.PLEDGE_NUMBER oldPledgeNumber, oee.PLEDGE_NUMBER * oee.Pledge_Face_Value oldPledStrdPrinAmt, T6.finprod_market_id oldFinprodMarketId, eted.DEAL_MODE dealMode, /** 申报类型 **/ nvl(nvl(fscr.SCALE * ete.ENTRUST_NUM,ee.PLEDGE_NUMBER * ee.PLEDGE_RATIO), ete.ENTRUST_NUM) pledgeStandardNumber, /** 标准券额度 **/ fp.Is_Right isRight,sci.ACCT_NAME trdAcctId, fp.FINPROD_TYPE2 finprodTypeTg, eted.DEAL_MODE declaType,T7.FINPROD_ID stockSecId FROM ETR_ENTRUST ete INNER JOIN ETR_ENTRUST_ADD eted ON ete.entrust_id = eted.entrust_id LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_CONVERTIBLE FPC ON ete.FINPROD_ID = FPC.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT T5 ON FPC.CON_FINPROD_ID = T5.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN PTL_PORTFOLIO pp ON ete.portfolio_id = pp.portfolio_id LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE fpt ON fpt.FINPROD_ID = ete.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT fp ON ete.finprod_id = fp.finprod_id
LEFT JOIN PTL_SEC_STOCK pss ON pss.pledge_stock_id = eted.pledge_stock_id AND ete.portfolio_id = pss.portfolio_id LEFT JOIN MST_CUSTOMER_INFO mci ON mci.CUSTOMER_ID = eted.main_consignee AND mci.IS_SALER = #{YESORNO_YES, jdbcType = VARCHAR} LEFT JOIN STL_SEC_ACCT_INFO ssai ON eted.SEC_ACCT_ID = ssai.SEC_ACCT_ID LEFT JOIN STL_CAPACCT_INFO sci ON sci.ACCT_NO = ssai.TRD_ACCT_ID LEFT JOIN etr_pledge ee ON ete.entrust_id = ee.entrust_id /** 委托指令回购质押品 **/ LEFT JOIN ETR_ENTRUST oete ON oete.entrust_id = eted.TRADE_ID LEFT JOIN etr_pledge oee ON oete.entrust_id = oee.entrust_id LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT T6 ON oete.FINPROD_ID = T6.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_STDSEC_CONVERSE_RADIO fscr ON ete.FINPROD_ID = fscr.FINPROD_ID AND fscr.VDATE <= to_date(#{sysDateStr},'yyyy-mm-dd') AND fscr.MDATE >= to_date(#{sysDateStr},'yyyy-mm-dd') LEFT JOIN ( SELECT ENTRUST_ID, wm_concat ( PORTFOLIO_ID ) PORTFOLIO_ID FROM ETR_ENTRUST_DETAIL GROUP BY ENTRUST_ID ) det ON det.ENTRUST_ID = ete.ENTRUST_ID left join MST_COUNTER_PARTY mcpdata on ete.COUNTER_ID = mcpdata.COUNTER_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT T7 ON ete.STOCK_ID = T7.FINPROD_MARKET_ID and ete.FINPROD_TYPE2 = T7.FINPROD_TYPE2 WHERE ete.entrust_id = #{entrustId} AND ( fscr.VDATE = ( select max(VDATE) from FIN_STDSEC_CONVERSE_RADIO fscr1 where fscr1.FINPROD_ID= fscr.FINPROD_ID and fscr1.BRANCH = fscr.BRANCH ) OR fscr.VDATE IS NULL ) union all

case when eted.BUSI_TYPE_POSITION in ('EX017','EX005') THEN round(ete.entrust_num/100,4) when ete.ps in ('T68','T69') THEN round(ete.entrust_num/100,4) else ete.entrust_num end entrustNum,
-- decode( -- eted.ASSET_TYPE, -- 'F01', -- /*decode(ete.PS,'T03',ete.ENTRUST_AMT,NVL(ete.ENTRUST_NUM * 100, 0 )),*/ -- decode(ete.PS,'T03',ete.ENTRUST_AMT,'03',ete.ENTRUST_AMT/100,'04',ete.ENTRUST_AMT/100,'T68',ete.ENTRUST_AMT/100,NVL(ete.ENTRUST_NUM * 100, 0 )), -- 'F10', -- NVL( ete.ENTRUST_NUM * 100, 0 ), -- 'F07', -- nvl(ete.ENTRUST_AMT/10000,0), -- NVL( ete.ENTRUST_AMT, ete.ENTRUST_NUM ) -- ) entrustAmt, case when #{busiTypePosition} = 'EX018' then round(nvl(ete.ENTRUST_AMT,0)/10000,3) when eted.ASSET_TYPE = 'F01' then NVL( ete.ENTRUST_NUM * eted.FULL_PRICE, 0 ) when eted.ASSET_TYPE = 'F10' then NVL( ete.ENTRUST_NUM * 100, 0 ) else NVL( ete.ENTRUST_AMT, ete.ENTRUST_NUM ) end as entrustAmt, eted.deal_mode dealMode, eted.term_type termType, to_char(eted.MDATE,'yyyy-MM-dd') || ' - ' || to_char(eted.MDATE2,'yyyy-MM-dd') as dueDate, eted.TERM_DAYS repoTerm, eted.FIRST_UNIT_CPRICE || ' - ' || eted.FIRST_UNIT_CPRICE2 firstprice, pss.pledge_stock_name pledgeStockName, eted.ASSET_TYPE assetType, ete.INV_MANAGER_ID invManagerId, eted.TARGET_TYPE targetType, mcpdata.COUNTER_NAME counterId, eted.COUNTER_SEAT counterSeat, eted.COUNTER_CON_NO counterConNo, eted.TRADER trader, ete.COUNTER_TRADER counterTrader, FPC.CON_SHARE_ID conId, T5.FINPROD_NAME conName, eted.EXP_CON_VALUE expConValue, eted.EXP_CON_NUM expConNum, eted.PREB preb, eted.PREC prec, fpt.TYPE_11 secType, sci.ACCT_NAME dealCurAcct, eted.REQUEST_ID requestId, eted.CAP_DAYS capDays, to_char(eted.VPAY_DATE,'yyyy-MM-dd') vpayDate, to_char(eted.MPAY_DATE,'yyyy-MM-dd') mpayDate, eted.M_INT_AMT mIntAmt, eted.M_TRADE_AMT mTradeAmt, nvl(decode( eted.ASSET_TYPE, 'F07' , ee.Pledge_Ratio , fscr.SCALE ), 0 ) * 100 pledgeRatio, /** 折算率 **/ ee.PLEDGE_NUMBER pledgeNumber, ee.PLEDGE_NUMBER * ee.Pledge_Face_Value pledStrdPrinAmt, eted.TRADE_ID tradeId, oee.Pledge_Ratio * 100 oldPledgeRatio, /** 折算率 **/ oee.PLEDGE_NUMBER oldPledgeNumber, oee.PLEDGE_NUMBER * oee.Pledge_Face_Value oldPledStrdPrinAmt, T6.finprod_market_id oldFinprodMarketId, eted.DEAL_MODE dealMode, /** 申报类型 **/ nvl(ee.PLEDGE_NUMBER * ee.PLEDGE_RATIO , ete.ENTRUST_NUM) pledgeStandardNumber, /** 标准券额度 **/ fp.Is_Right isRight,sci.ACCT_NAME trdAcctId, fp.FINPROD_TYPE2 finprodTypeTg, eted.DEAL_MODE declaType,T7.FINPROD_ID stockSecId FROM WFL_ETR_ENTRUST ete INNER JOIN WFL_ETR_ENTRUST_ADD eted ON ete.entrust_id = eted.entrust_id LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_CONVERTIBLE FPC ON ete.FINPROD_ID = FPC.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT T5 ON FPC.CON_FINPROD_ID = T5.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN PTL_PORTFOLIO pp ON ete.portfolio_id = pp.portfolio_id LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE fpt ON fpt.FINPROD_ID = ete.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT fp ON ete.finprod_id = fp.finprod_id
LEFT JOIN PTL_SEC_STOCK pss ON pss.pledge_stock_id = eted.pledge_stock_id AND ete.portfolio_id = pss.portfolio_id LEFT JOIN MST_CUSTOMER_INFO mci ON mci.CUSTOMER_ID = eted.main_consignee AND mci.IS_SALER = #{YESORNO_YES, jdbcType = VARCHAR} LEFT JOIN STL_SEC_ACCT_INFO ssai ON eted.SEC_ACCT_ID = ssai.SEC_ACCT_ID LEFT JOIN STL_CAPACCT_INFO sci ON sci.ACCT_NO = ssai.TRD_ACCT_ID LEFT JOIN wfl_etr_pledge ee ON ete.entrust_id = ee.entrust_id /** 委托指令回购质押品 **/ LEFT JOIN ETR_ENTRUST oete ON oete.entrust_id = eted.TRADE_ID LEFT JOIN etr_pledge oee ON oete.entrust_id = oee.entrust_id LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT T6 ON oete.FINPROD_ID = T6.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_STDSEC_CONVERSE_RADIO fscr ON ete.FINPROD_ID = fscr.FINPROD_ID AND fscr.VDATE <= to_date(#{sysDateStr},'yyyy-mm-dd') AND fscr.MDATE >= to_date(#{sysDateStr},'yyyy-mm-dd') LEFT JOIN ( SELECT ENTRUST_ID, wm_concat ( PORTFOLIO_ID ) PORTFOLIO_ID FROM WFL_ETR_ENTRUST_DETAIL GROUP BY ENTRUST_ID ) det ON det.ENTRUST_ID = ete.ENTRUST_ID left join MST_COUNTER_PARTY mcpdata on ete.COUNTER_ID = mcpdata.COUNTER_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT T7 ON ete.STOCK_ID = T7.FINPROD_MARKET_ID and ete.FINPROD_TYPE2 = T7.FINPROD_TYPE2 WHERE ete.entrust_id = #{entrustId}
